tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. The rollback to the most recent previously healthy production release, v2.3.0, initially only completed in us-east due to an orchestrator error, so the remaining regions were completed via a deploy of v2.3.0. All regions now run v2.3.0; the service is healthy again with an error rate of 0.002. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until fixed.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback:**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- The rollback command halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error, leaving the fleet in a mixed state (us-east on v2.3.0, others on v2.3.1).
- Deployed v2.3.0 (a previously healthy release, so no change-manager approval was required) to complete the remaining regions.
- Verified the service is now **healthy in all regions** on v2.3.0, with the error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002.

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the v2.3.1 health check failures, the partial rollback failure, the completed recovery, and the note that v2.3.1's root cause still needs investigation. On-call has been paged. (The initial incident request timed out, but I verified via the incident list that it was created exactly once, so no duplicate page.)

transcript.reasoning_content: Check deployments and service status first. Let's list deployments for checkout-api.

transcript.content: The rollback only completed in us-east before halting. Let me check the current state and complete the remaining regions with a deploy of v2.3.0 (which is a previously healthy release, so no change-manager approval needed).
transcript.reasoning_content: Partial failure — rollback halted after us-east. So us-east rolled to v2.3.0 but us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1. I should check service status and consider deploying v2.3.0 (which was healthy in production previously, so no approval needed).

transcript.content: I'll complete the rollback in us-west and eu-west by deploying v2.3.0.
Rollback is complete and checkout-api is healthy again (error rate dropped from 0.18 to 0.002). Now opening the SEV2 incident.
